milestones.title: Skeleton compiles and links
milestones.goal: The crate builds against the scaffold with every declared module present (lib.rs, inversion_list.rs), library init/finish (`inversion_list_init`/`inversion_list_finish`-equivalent setup) works, and the entrypoint runs without panics. No functional behaviour is asserted yet.

milestones.title: Struct creation and destruction
milestones.goal: InversionList can be constructed from a capacity, a count and a slice of values (mirroring `inversion_list_create`) and safely dropped (mirroring `inversion_list_destroy`), preserving field layout (capacity/support) and basic invariants.

milestones.title: Getters and creation edge cases
milestones.goal: Capacity and support accessors (`inversion_list_capacity`, `inversion_list_support`) return correct values, and creation correctly handles edge cases such as empty value sets, values exceeding capacity, and duplicate/unsorted input (mirroring the additional create/destroy edge-case coverage).

milestones.title: Membership queries
milestones.goal: `inversion_list_member`-equivalent membership testing returns correct results for values inside and outside the set, including boundary values.

milestones.title: Cloning
milestones.goal: Cloning a set (mirroring `inversion_list_clone`) produces an independent, equal copy with no shared mutable state.

milestones.title: String conversion
milestones.goal: Converting a set to its string representation (mirroring `inversion_list_to_string`) matches the C formatting exactly, including for the empty set.

milestones.title: Equality and ordering comparisons
milestones.goal: Set comparison operators (equal, not_equal, less, less_equal, greater, greater_equal, disjoint — mirroring `inversion_list_equal`/`_not_equal`/`_less`/`_less_equal`/`_greater`/`_greater_equal`/`_disjoint`) produce results consistent with set semantics.

milestones.title: Value iterator
milestones.goal: An iterator over individual set members (mirroring `inversion_list_iterator_create`/`_next`/`_rewind`/`_valid`/`_get`) visits every member in order exactly once and correctly reports validity/exhaustion.

milestones.title: Couple (range) iterator
milestones.goal: An iterator over the set's inf/sup range couples (mirroring `inversion_list_couple_iterator_create`/`_next`/`_rewind`/`_valid`/`_get_inf`/`_get_sup`) visits every contiguous range exactly once with correct bounds.

milestones.title: Set algebra operations
milestones.goal: Complement, union, intersection, difference and symmetric difference (mirroring `inversion_list_complement`/`_union`/`_intersection`/`_difference`/`_symmetric_difference`) produce sets matching standard set-algebra semantics over multiple operands.

milestones.title: Golden conformance
milestones.goal: The full translation reproduces the complete C `inversion-list` contract: every prior slice still passes together with the whole held-out suite, with no regressions introduced by later milestones.
